# API リファレンス

wpg-server は `/api` 以下で REST (JSON) API を提供し、リアルタイム統計・ジョブの状態変化・ログを WebSocket (`GET /api/ws`) で配信します。このページはサーバの OpenAPI ドキュメント (utoipa) から自動生成しています。起動中のサーバは同じドキュメントを `/api/openapi.json` で、Swagger UI を `/api/docs/` で提供し、写しを [`docs/schema/openapi.json`](https://github.com/SeiyaFunaokaJP/web-packet-generator/blob/main/docs/schema/openapi.json) に置いています。`POST /api/auth/login` (初回は `POST /api/auth/setup`) でログインすると、以降は `wpg_session` クッキーで認証されます。POST / PUT / DELETE では `GET /api/auth/status` の CSRF トークンを `X-CSRF-Token` ヘッダでも送ってください。エラーは JSON オブジェクト `error` で、`code`、`message` (`Accept-Language` の言語)、`details` を持ちます。以下のエンドポイントとスキーマの説明はコード由来 (英語) です。

|---|---|---|

| auth | [`POST /api/auth/logout`](#op-post-api-auth-logout) | Logs out (needs `X-CSRF-Token` when the session is live) and clears the cookies. |
| auth | [`POST /api/auth/setup`](#op-post-api-auth-setup) | First-run setup: sets the admin password and logs in. Only while no password is configured, and only from a loopback client unless the server runs with `--allow-insecure`. Requires `Content-Type: application/json`. |
| auth | [`GET /api/auth/status`](#op-get-api-auth-status) | Authentication state of the caller (never requires a session). |

### `auth`

ログイン、ログアウト、初回セットアップ。

<a id="op-post-api-auth-login"></a>

#### `POST /api/auth/login`

Logs in (rate limited per client address: 5 failures a minute, then an exponentially growing lock-out up to 15 minutes). Requires `Content-Type: application/json`.

**リクエスト本文**: `application/json` [`LoginRequest`](#schema-loginrequest)

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Logged in; `Set-Cookie`: `wpg_session`, `wpg_csrf` |   |
| `401` | `unauthorized` / `setup_required` | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |
| `415` | Not JSON | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |
| `429` | `rate_limited`: `details.retry_after_secs`, `Retry-After` | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |

<a id="op-post-api-auth-logout"></a>

#### `POST /api/auth/logout`

Logs out (needs `X-CSRF-Token` when the session is live) and clears the cookies.

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Logged out |   |
| `403` | `csrf_failed` | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |

<a id="op-post-api-auth-setup"></a>

#### `POST /api/auth/setup`

First-run setup: sets the admin password and logs in. Only while no password is configured, and only from a loopback client unless the server runs with `--allow-insecure`. Requires `Content-Type: application/json`.

**リクエスト本文**: `application/json` [`SetupRequest`](#schema-setuprequest)

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Password set; `Set-Cookie`: `wpg_session`, `wpg_csrf` |   |
| `400` | Passwords differ / too short | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |
| `403` | `forbidden`: remote client | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |
| `409` | `already_configured` | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |
| `415` | Not JSON | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |

<a id="op-get-api-auth-status"></a>

#### `GET /api/auth/status`

Authentication state of the caller (never requires a session).

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | State | `application/json` [`AuthStatus`](#schema-authstatus) |

**リクエスト本文**: `application/json` [`ReceiverStart`](#schema-receiverstart)

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Listening | `application/json` [`ReceiverStatus`](#schema-receiverstatus) |
| `400` | Bad address / users | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |
| `502` | `backend_error`: cannot bind (privileged port, in use) | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |

<a id="op-post-api-snmp-receiver-stop"></a>

#### `POST /api/snmp/receiver/stop`

Stops the receiver.

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Stopped | `application/json` [`ReceiverStatus`](#schema-receiverstatus) |

<a id="op-post-api-snmp-set"></a>

#### `POST /api/snmp/set`

`SetRequest`.

**リクエスト本文**: `application/json` [`SnmpSetRequest`](#schema-snmpsetrequest)

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Response (check `error_status`: notWritable, wrongType, ...) | `application/json` [`SnmpResult`](#schema-snmpresult) |
| `400` | Bad target / OID / value | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |
| `502` | `snmp_error` | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |
| `504` | `snmp_error`: no response | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |

<a id="op-get-api-snmp-status"></a>

#### `GET /api/snmp/status`

Whether the SNMP tool is enabled, with MIB / receiver / recording summaries.

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Status | `application/json` [`SnmpStatus`](#schema-snmpstatus) |

<a id="op-post-api-snmp-trap"></a>

#### `POST /api/snmp/trap`

Sends a trap (v1 Trap-PDU, SNMPv2-Trap, or a v3 trap with this server as the authoritative engine). The result lists the bindings sent.

**リクエスト本文**: `application/json` [`SnmpNotifyRequest`](#schema-snmpnotifyrequest)

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Sent | `application/json` [`SnmpResult`](#schema-snmpresult) |
| `400` | Bad request | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |

<a id="op-get-api-snmp-traps"></a>

#### `GET /api/snmp/traps`

Received notifications, newest first (also pushed as `snmp_trap` events on the WebSocket).

**パラメータ**

| 名前 | 位置 | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | path | `integer` \| `null` | はい | Most notifications (default 200, at most 1000). |

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Notifications | `application/json` [`TrapOut`](#schema-trapout)`[]` |

<a id="op-delete-api-snmp-traps"></a>

#### `DELETE /api/snmp/traps`

Forgets the received notifications.

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Cleared |   |

<a id="op-post-api-snmp-walk"></a>

#### `POST /api/snmp/walk`

Walks a subtree (GetBulk on v2c / v3, GetNext on v1); conceptual tables in the result are also returned as rows × columns.

**リクエスト本文**: `application/json` [`SnmpWalkRequest`](#schema-snmpwalkrequest)

**レスポンス**

| ステータス | 説明 | 本文 |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Bindings and tables | `application/json` [`SnmpResult`](#schema-snmpresult) |
| `400` | Bad request | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |
| `502` | `snmp_error` | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |
| `504` | `snmp_error`: no response | `application/json` [`ErrorBody`](#schema-errorbody) |

## スキーマ

上記で参照しているリクエスト・レスポンス本文の型です。

<a id="schema-activesession"></a>

A running session (`GET /api/terminal/status`).

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |

| `host` | `string` | はい | Target host as entered. |
| `id` | `string` | はい | Session id. |
| `log` | `string` \| `null` |   | Log file being written, if recording. |
| `port` | `integer` | はい | Target port. |
| `protocol` | [`Protocol`](#schema-protocol) | はい | Protocol. |
| `started` | `integer` | はい | Start (Unix seconds). |
| `user` | `string` | はい | wpg user who opened it. |

### `AuthStatus`

`GET /api/auth/status`.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `authenticated` | `boolean` | はい | The request carries a valid session. |
| `configured` | `boolean` | はい | A password exists (configured or set on the setup screen). |
| `csrf_token` | `string` \| `null` |   | CSRF token to send as `X-CSRF-Token` on POST / PUT / DELETE (also in the `wpg_csrf` cookie); `null` when not logged in. |
| `setup_required` | `boolean` | はい | No password yet: show the setup screen (`POST /api/auth/setup`). |
| `user` | [`UserInfo`](#schema-userinfo) \| `null` |   |   |

### `BackendItem`

One transmit backend.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `available` | `boolean` | はい | Compiled in and supported on this OS (privileges not checked). |
| `multi_worker` | `boolean` | はい | Several TX workers per job. |
| `name` | `string` | はい | Name (`null`, `pcapfile`, `afpacket`, `pcap`, `afxdp`, `dpdk`). |
| `reason` | `string` \| `null` |   | Why it is unavailable / requirements. |

### `Backends`

`GET /api/system/backends` response body.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|

| `default` | `string` | はい | Backend used when a job names none. |

### `CaptureControl`

`POST /api/snmp/capture` body.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clear` | `boolean` |   | Discard the recorded frames first. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` \| `null` |   | Start (`true`) / stop (`false`) recording. |

<a id="schema-captureinfo"></a>

### `CaptureInfo`

A capture as returned by the API.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `string` | はい | Resolved backend. |
| `filter` | `string` | はい | Normalised filter text (empty = every frame). |
| `finished` | `integer` \| `null` |   | End time, Unix milliseconds. |
| `id` | `string` | はい | Capture id. |
| `iface` | `string` | はい | Resolved interface (input path for `pcapfile`). |
| `name` | `string` | はい | Display name (`spec.name`, else `<backend>:<iface>`). |
| `saved` | `boolean` | はい | Whether a pcapng file was written (download with `GET /api/captures/{id}/pcapng`). |
| `spec` | [`CaptureSpec`](#schema-capturespec) | はい | The request. |
| `started` | `integer` | はい | Start time, Unix milliseconds. |
| `stats` | `object` \| `null` |   | Latest statistics (`wpg_rx::RxSnapshot`). |
| `status` | `object` | はい | `{ "state": "running" }`, `{ "state": "finished", "detail": "count_reached" \| "duration_elapsed" \| "end_of_input" \| "stopped" }`, `{ "state": "failed", "detail": "<error>" }`. |

<a id="schema-capturespec"></a>

### `CaptureSpec`

What to capture (all fields are optional).

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `string` \| `null` |   | Backend: `afpacket`, `pcap`, `pcapfile`, `null` (default: `afpacket` on Linux, else `pcap`). |
| `count` | `integer` \| `null` |   | Stop after this many matching frames. |
| `duration` | `string` \| `null` |   | Stop after this long, e.g. `10s`, `2m`. |
| `filter` | `string` \| `null` |   | tcpdump-style filter (`udp port 5001 and wpg`); empty = every frame. |
| `iface` | `string` \| `null` |   | Interface (`any` = every interface with `afpacket`); for `pcapfile` the name of a capture file under `<data_dir>/captures` (e.g. a dry-run output). |
| `include_outgoing` | `boolean` |   | Also count frames this host transmits. |
| `keep` | `integer` |   | Matching frames kept for display (default 100, at most 10000). |
| `name` | `string` \| `null` |   | Display name. |
| `promisc` | `boolean` |   | Promiscuous mode. |
| `save` | `string` \| `null` |   | Save the matching frames as a pcapng file of this name under `<data_dir>/captures`. |
| `verify` | `boolean` |   | Check the signatures of matching frames (loss / order / latency). |

<a id="schema-capturestatus"></a>

### `CaptureStatus`

pcap recording state.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dropped` | `integer` | はい | Frames dropped because the buffer was full. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | はい | Recording. |
| `frames` | `integer` | はい | Kept frames. |

### `CapturedFrame`

One kept frame.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hex` | `string` | はい | Captured octets as lower-case hex (decode with `POST /api/parse`). |
| `index` | `integer` | はい | Position among the matching frames (0-based). |
| `len` | `integer` | はい | Original length. |
| `signature` | `object` \| `null` |   | The frame's signature (`stream_id`, `seq`, `ts_ns`), if any. |
| `ts_ns` | `integer` | はい | Capture time, nanoseconds since the Unix epoch. |

A job as returned by the API (also the persisted history record).

<a id="schema-jobspec"></a>

### `JobSpec`

What to send, where and how (all fields but `streams` are optional).

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backend` | `string` \| `null` |   | Backend: `null`, `pcapfile`, `afpacket`, `pcap`, ... (default: `tx.default_backend`). |
| `batch` | `integer` \| `null` |   | Frames per `send_batch` call. |
| `burst` | `integer` \| `null` |   | Frames per rate-control grant. |
| `count` | `integer` \| `null` |   | Total packets (default: the template's `tx.count` for a single stream). |
| `dry_run` | `string` \| `null` |   | Dry run: write a pcapng file of this name under `<data_dir>/captures` instead of sending (forces the `pcapfile` backend). |
| `duration` | `string` \| `null` |   | Duration limit, e.g. `10s`, `2m`. |
| `iface` | `string` \| `null` |   | Interface (not needed for `null`; the output file name for `pcapfile`). |
| `mix` | [`Mix`](#schema-mix) |   | Interleaving of several streams. |
| `name` | `string` \| `null` |   | Display name. |
| `pin_cores` | `integer``[]` |   | Core per worker (Linux). |
| `plan` | `string` \| `null` |   | Expansion strategy: `auto`, `prerender`, `onthefly`. |
| `ramp_up` | `string` \| `null` |   | Linear rate ramp-up time, e.g. `5s`. |
| `rate` | `string` \| `null` |   | Rate: `1000pps`, `1Mpps`, `10Gbps`, `50%`, `ifg=10us`, `unlimited` (default: the first template's `tx.rate`, then `tx.max_rate`, else unlimited). |
| `signature` | `boolean` |   | Stamp every frame with a receive-verification signature (magic + stream id + sequence number + TX time over the last 24 payload octets; see `/api/captures` with `verify`). |
| `start_at` | `string` \| `null` |   | Scheduled start: RFC 3339 or `+10s`. |
| `stream_id` | `integer` \| `null` |   | Signature stream id of the first stream (stream `i` gets `stream_id + i`; default 0). |
| `streams` | [`JobStream`](#schema-jobstream)`[]` |   | Streams (at least one). Several streams are mixed into one TX worker. |
| `workers` | `integer` \| `null` |   | TX worker threads (single stream only). |

<a id="schema-jobstatus"></a>

### `JobStatus`

Job lifecycle state: `{ "state": "running" }`, `{ "state": "finished",
"detail": "count_reached" }`, `{ "state": "failed", "detail": "<error>" }`.

#### `state: "created"`

Created with `start: false`, not started yet.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `"created"` | はい |   |

#### `state: "scheduled"`

Waiting for `start_at`.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `"scheduled"` | はい |   |

#### `state: "running"`

Sending.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `"running"` | はい |   |

#### `state: "paused"`

Paused.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `"paused"` | はい |   |

#### `state: "finished"`

Ended normally (`count_reached`, `duration_elapsed`, `source_exhausted`,
`stopped`).

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `detail` | [`EndReason`](#schema-endreason) | はい | Ended normally (`count_reached`, `duration_elapsed`, `source_exhausted`, `stopped`). |
| `state` | `"finished"` | はい |   |

#### `state: "failed"`

Ended with an error.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `detail` | `string` | はい | Ended with an error. |
| `state` | `"failed"` | はい |   |

| `enabled` | `boolean` | はい | Record from now on. |
| `strip_ansi` | `boolean` \| `null` |   | Remove escape sequences (default true). |
| `type` | `"record"` | はい |   |

#### `type: "disconnect"`

Ends the session.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `"disconnect"` | はい |   |

<a id="schema-terminalconnectrequest"></a>

### `TerminalConnectRequest`

`connect`: where to and how to log in.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cols` | `integer` |   | Terminal width. |
| `host` | `string` | はい | Host name or address. |
| `passphrase` | `string` \| `null` |   | Passphrase of `private_key`. |
| `password` | `string` \| `null` |   | SSH password (also answers a single keyboard-interactive password prompt). |
| `port` | `integer` \| `null` |   | Port (default 22 / 23). |
| `private_key` | `string` \| `null` |   | SSH private key (OpenSSH / PEM / `PuTTY` `.ppk` text). |
| `protocol` | [`Protocol`](#schema-protocol) | はい | `ssh` or `telnet`. |
| `record` | `boolean` \| `null` |   | Record a session log (default: `terminal.record_sessions`). |
| `rows` | `integer` |   | Terminal height. |
| `strip_ansi` | `boolean` \| `null` |   | Remove escape sequences from the log (default true). |
| `username` | `string` \| `null` |   | SSH user name. |

<a id="schema-terminalservermessage"></a>

### `TerminalServerMessage`

Server → client message on `/api/terminal/ws`. Remote output travels as
binary frames.

#### `type: "state"`

Progress: `resolving`, `connecting`, `authenticating`.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `string` | はい | The phase. |
| `type` | `"state"` | はい |   |

#### `type: "host_key"`

An unknown SSH host key: confirm the fingerprint (`host_key` message).

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `algorithm` | `string` | はい | Key algorithm. |
| `fingerprint` | `string` | はい | `SHA256:...`. |
| `host` | `string` | はい | Host. |
| `port` | `integer` | はい | Port. |
| `type` | `"host_key"` | はい |   |

#### `type: "auth_prompt"`

The server asks questions (keyboard-interactive, or the password when
none was given): answer with `auth_response`.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instructions` | `string` | はい | Instructions from the server. |
| `name` | `string` | はい | Request name from the server. |
| `prompts` | [`PromptItem`](#schema-promptitem)`[]` | はい | The prompts. |
| `type` | `"auth_prompt"` | はい |   |

#### `type: "connected"`

The session is up.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | `string` | はい | Address actually connected to. |
| `fingerprint` | `string` \| `null` |   | SSH host key fingerprint. |
| `host` | `string` | はい | Host. |
| `port` | `integer` | はい | Port. |
| `protocol` | [`Protocol`](#schema-protocol) | はい | Protocol. |
| `session_id` | `string` | はい | Session id. |
| `type` | `"connected"` | はい |   |

#### `type: "record"`

Log state after `connected` / `record`.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `boolean` | はい | Recording. |
| `file` | `string` \| `null` |   | The log file (`GET /api/terminal/logs/{name}`). |
| `type` | `"record"` | はい |   |

#### `type: "error"`

A failure; `fatal` ones are followed by `closed`.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | `string` | はい | `target_not_allowed`, `too_many_sessions`, `resolve_failed`, `connect_failed`, `host_key_changed`, `host_key_rejected`, `auth_failed`, `key_invalid`, `ssh_error`, `timeout`, `bad_request`, `recording_disabled`, `log_failed`. |
| `detail` | `string` \| `null` |   | Untranslated detail (an OS / protocol error). |
| `fatal` | `boolean` | はい | The session ends. |
| `info` | `object` \| `null` |   | `host_key_changed`: `{algorithm, fingerprint, known_algorithm, known_fingerprint}`. |
| `type` | `"error"` | はい |   |

#### `type: "closed"`

The session ended.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bytes_in` | `integer` | はい | Bytes received from the host. |
| `bytes_out` | `integer` | はい | Bytes sent to the host. |
| `duration_secs` | `integer` | はい | Session length in seconds. |
| `reason` | `string` | はい | `remote` (the host closed it), `client`, `idle`, `shutdown`, `error`. |
| `type` | `"closed"` | はい |   |

### `TerminalStatus`

`GET /api/terminal/status`.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |

<a id="schema-trapout"></a>

### `TrapOut`

A received notification.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `acknowledged` | `boolean` | はい | An inform that was acknowledged. |
| `community` | `string` \| `null` |   | Community (v1 / v2c). |

| `id` | `integer` | はい | Sequence number (increasing). |
| `level` | `string` \| `null` |   | v3 security level. |
| `pdu_type` | `string` \| `null` |   | `trap_v1`, `trap_v2`, `inform` (absent when undecodable). |
| `received_ms` | `integer` | はい | Arrival, milliseconds since the Unix epoch. |

| `trap_oid` | `string` \| `null` |   | `snmpTrapOID.0` (dotted). |
| `uptime` | `integer` \| `null` |   | `sysUpTime.0` / v1 time-stamp (hundredths of a second). |
| `uptime_text` | `string` \| `null` |   | Uptime as `1d 02:03:04.56`. |
| `user` | `string` \| `null` |   | User (v3). |
| `v1` | [`V1Out`](#schema-v1out) \| `null` |   |   |
| `varbinds` | [`VarBindOut`](#schema-varbindout)`[]` | はい | Bindings (without `sysUpTime.0` / `snmpTrapOID.0`). |
| `version` | `string` | はい | `v1`, `v2c`, `v3`. |

<a id="schema-v3in"></a>

### `V3In`

SNMPv3 parameters. The level follows from the pass phrases given:
none = noAuthNoPriv, `auth_password` = authNoPriv, both = authPriv.

| キー | 型 | 必須 | 説明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auth_password` | `string` \| `null` |   | Authentication pass phrase (at least 8 characters). |
| `auth_protocol` | `string` \| `null` |   | `MD5`, `SHA` (SHA-1), `SHA-224`, `SHA-256`, `SHA-384`, `SHA-512` (default `SHA`). |
| `context_engine_id` | `string` \| `null` |   | `contextEngineID` (hex; default: the agent's engine id). |
| `context_name` | `string` \| `null` |   | `contextName`. |
| `priv_password` | `string` \| `null` |   | Privacy pass phrase (at least 8 characters). |
| `priv_protocol` | `string` \| `null` |   | `DES`, `AES` (AES-128), `AES-192`, `AES-256` (default `AES`). |
| `user` | `string` | はい | User name. |

A variable binding to send (Set, notifications).

| `value` | `string` |   | Value text (enum labels such as `down` and object names are accepted). |
